scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @retroverse/server" "npm run dev -w @retroverse/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @retroverse/web && npm run build -w @retroverse/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
